basic_info.main_problem: 近几个月以来,我持续感到自己是一个糟糕的舞伴/Teacher,并相信without人来上我的舞蹈课就是因为I am not good enough.这种not足感影响了我的自信,使我在每次舞蹈课或涉及跳舞的Social situations前都感到Anxiety和Self-doubt.
basic_info.core_demands: 这些not足感已经影响我对跳舞的享受和整体自信,我希望通过咨询改善这种状况.
growth_experiences: 几个月前在一次舞蹈课上Being criticized,此后将批评与自我价值直接关联:每次上课前出现Anxiety并怀疑能力;认为课程without人到场是因为自己not够好;逐渐回避涉及跳舞的Social gatherings.期间尝试提升舞蹈技巧并得到正面反馈,但仍持续感到not足.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough/I am a terrible dance partner与Teacher
Others' attendance and evaluations determine my worth

special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Practices twice as much and considers adjusting class times to prove himself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: have not人来是因为他们not喜欢我的教学/我很糟糕

special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am terrible

special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这些好评not代表我真的够好

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认可与被喜欢,作为Dancer和Teacher得到肯定
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被批评与被negate,担心without人到场意味着自己not被需要
defense_goal: 通过自责与回避来降低被negate的风险

object_relations.object_representation: Picky others/audiences (who will judge me by attendance and criticism)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当讨论舞蹈课的低出勤或回想起Being criticized时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 他人not喜欢我,I am not good enough(将外部状况等同于对自我的negate)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以自责的语气表达,use绝对化词语(如'都是因为我not好'),淡化或忽视外部因素.
